v3-7.candidate: And all the livestock and the spoil of the cities we took as plunder for ourselves.

v3-19.candidate: Only let your wives, and your children, and your livestock, for I know that you have much livestock, dwell in your cities which I have given you,

v3-26.candidate: And the Lord disregarded me because of you, and did not hearken unto me; and the Lord said unto me: Let it suffice you; speak no more of this matter.
v3-26.close: And the Lord disregarded me for your sakes, and did not hearken unto me; and the Lord said unto me: Let it suffice you; speak no more of this matter.
